name: Uday Sankar Obbu
headline: Java Full Stack Developer building scalable, event-driven platforms.
description: Java Full Stack Developer with 4.7 years of experience in microservices, distributed systems and cloud, building high-availability platforms for regulated gaming.
about: I have spent 4.7 years building high-availability platforms for regulated gaming: Java 17 / Spring Boot microservices, Kafka and RabbitMQ event-driven systems, and Angular / React frontends running on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes.

I own features end to end: HLD/LLD, implementation, code review, OWASP-aware secure coding, testing, CI/CD and production support. I am a co-inventor on a patent (granted 2025) for a reusable enterprise platform framework adopted across multiple product teams.
